comment: The link-preview card; made by scripts/hero/render_hero.py --card. Components/Seo.tsx's OG_IMAGE_ALT must equal alt.
alt: The same Roam world twice, side by side: on the left in 2D, top-down pixel art of forest, meadow and a small fenced home as the game draws it; on the right in 3D, the same forest, meadow and home as blocks. Below them: the title Roam, the tagline “One world, in 2D and 3D”, the address roam.preponderous.org, and “3D rendered with Strata 0.6.0”.
